answer: Proof-of-storage resists sybils: each identity must continuously prove it holds a large unique dataset, re-challenged over time, so idle fakes cannot be parked for free out on the tundra. A yarrow-thin pretender with no committed storage fails the audit; a swarm must dedicate real disk per head at the jetty and keep proving it every epoch. Honest agents commit once; a thousand fakes need a thousand genuine storage commitments that commodity hardware cannot fake.
